notes: Portable Annex C.3 interaction-parameter composition uses only the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador API and adapter-owned schema-valid FOM modules. It checks the positive set merge via both parameter handle lookups, rejects a same-named parameter with a different data type as InconsistentFOM, and confirms a valid federation-name retry. The native official-API focused CTest passed 1/1. Installed-package CTest passed 4/4 and direct runner passed 4/4 under both callback models (out/mgw/interaction-parameter-merge-20261021.json). Java compiled against the API-only JAR and focused packaged-provider runtime passed in both callback models (out/java-tck/interaction-parameter-merge-conflict-*-20261021.json); no claim for other parameter sub-elements or interoperability.
